282034285.description:
Natural History Fossil Specimen
Fish Fossil in Sedimentary Rock Matrix
Natural Limestone Slab, 5.25 x 3.5 Inches
This authentic fossil fish specimen is preserved within a cut sedimentary rock matrix slab. The fossil displays articulate anatomical preservation, highlighting the vertebral column, rib structures, fins, and caudal tail. Natural vertebrate fossils from sedimentary lakebed deposits are prized display pieces among natural history collectors and paleontology enthusiasts.
Genuine articulated bony fish fossil specimen in natural stone matrix
Observable anatomical details include spinal vertebrae, rib rays, and fin structures
Cut rectangular slab displaying natural sedimentary layering along edges
Measures approximately 5.25 inches long, 3.5 inches wide, 0.75 inches thick; weighs 1.2 lbs
Condition:
The fossil skeletal structure is well-defined with distinct dark brown mineral coloration contrasting against the tan matrix. Stone slab is solid and stable, displaying natural edge wear, minor chipping, and layered sediment lines typical of quarried specimens. Reverse shows natural texture with faint marking. No repairs or structural fractures.
